title: Air Force documents on Hans Kohler's capture by the Americans

tellings.quote: we now even have air force documents knowing that we Hans Conler was apprehended by the Americans.

plain: In Germany in the 1940s, a man named Hans Kohler is said to have been caught by American forces. Michels tells this himself, saying "we now even have air force documents" showing Kohler "was apprehended by the Americans," though he does not quote them further. If true, it would place Kohler in American hands after the war.
